links.outcome: AI platform vs experienced endodontists on sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, AUC against CBCT reference standard
links.effect: AI sensitivity higher (67.3% vs 49.3% tooth) but specificity lower (82.3% vs 92.5%); accuracy comparable at tooth level (76.3% vs 75.3%), lower at root level (78.5% vs 81.6%); AUC 0.75 vs 0.71.
links.quote: The AI-driven platform demonstrated higher sensitivity but lower specificity than clinicians at both tooth (sensitivity: 67.3% vs 49.3%, P < .001; specificity: 82.3% vs 92.5%, P < .001) and root levels (sensitivity: 54.3% vs 43.8%, P = .003; specificity: 86.7% vs 94.5%, P < .001).

screen.reason: Retrospective diagnostic accuracy study comparing a commercial AI platform (Diagnocat) to endodontists on periapical radiographs, with no specific deployment guardrail or workflow practice tested.
